explication: Nuklear is an embeddable, immediate-mode C UI toolkit: an application supplies input each frame, builds UI through the API, and consumes the resulting draw commands in its own renderer. Its modules cover window/layout composition, interactive controls, text editing and fonts, styling, and optional vertex conversion. The README documents the frame-level flow and the toolkit’s capabilities; source excerpts are partial, so internal links are limited to relationships they show or the README states.
